patch_description: Replaces the three-parameter block with a symmetry-preserving two-axis mixer: a collective RY preparation layer, the depth-optimized complete-graph CZ entangler, and a collective RX readout mixer. Removing the intermediate RZ layer reduces the model from 20 to 14 total parameters and removes 48 gates across the six blocks. The remaining noncommuting RY/CZ/RX sequence retains data-dependent phase-to-population conversion, while independent copies across uploads and repeats preserve expressivity. This should improve parameter efficiency, reduce depth and overfitting risk, and accelerate Adam convergence without changing the fixed feature map, re-uploading schedule, readout, training loop, inputs, or outputs.
